full_judgment: 2. The plaint case in short is that the plaintiff instituted the Title Suit No.295 of 1995 in the court of Assistant Judge, 2nd Court. Dhaka impleading the above defendant-petitioners and opposite parties Nos, 2-7 praying for declaration of title in the suit land and also further declaration that the kabala No.8593 dated 8-8-1959 is forged, illegal and not binding upon the plaintiffs and stated, inter alia, that one Jalaluddin of village Nayanagar, Tejgaon, Dhaka had been the original owner of the suit land along with other lands. The CS Khatian was prepared in the name of the Mamud Ali Sheikh and after him his son Jalaluddin who has been in possession of the suit land by paying rem. Thereafter, he would the suit land along with other lands measuring all area of 0.34 decimals at a consideration of Taka 1500 by a registered kabala dated 12-5-1960 and handed over vacant possession of the land to, the purchaser. Since then the plaintiff has been possessing the suit land as an exclusive owner by paying rent in ejmali for more than 12 years by mutating his name. SA Parcha prepared in the name of previous owner Jalaluddin and the RS Parcha, thereafter, had prepared ill the name of the plaintiff. The price of the suit land has gone up and the defendant No.1 for his illegal gain advanced claim in the suit land on 15-10-1995 disclosing that there is a deed in his favour and showed Photostat copy of the deed No.5893 dated 8-5-1959 contained in Book No. 1. Volume No.19 pages 292-293 of the Sub-Registrar's Office, Kaligan, The plaintiff made an enquiry in the Sub-Registrar Office. Kaliganj but could not trace the deed in the book and Volume, but found a deed at page No.291 and 292 being deed No. 2444 dated 7-3-1959 and at pages 293-294 another deed No.2445 dated 14-2-1959 and in both the deeds vendors and the vendees are different, but there is no mention of the name of the defendant No.1 Shahjahan and that the deed claimed by the defendants is forged and collusive and by such deed no title  accrued to the defendants and the Same also is not binding upon the plaintiff. Thereafter, the plaintiff filed this suit for the relief's mentioned the plaint. In the plaint the Government of Bangladesh and the Assistant Commissioner (Land) Were impleaded as defendants, the above petitioners,
